stance_rationale: Nominal IC and ICIR pass, but the alpha handoff is not actionable: the claimed LightGBM ensemble did not execute, the top-20 alpha vector violates the mandated KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 universe, liquidity is computed from Size instead of true trading value, and turnover exceeds the hard cap. AX-008 also fails because requested downstream artifacts and three-agent context are absent.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: RF-A7 single-snapshot risk is low because alpha_scores.parquet has 182 dates and no future dates, but monthly schedule consistency fails with 10 missing calendar months, and the requested A-stage path is absent.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: factor_engine_proposal.R directly reads raw daily factors and marks Z_Score_Aligned as N/A; no NEGATE_FACTORS pattern was found, but the role prompt requires Z_Score_Aligned-only handling.
No Usable_Date <= sig_date enforcement is present for factor_db_daily inputs; PIT safety is asserted through registry language rather than audited in-code.
The engine uses open_dataset(.cache/factor_db_daily/*.parquet) and explicitly states load_month_factors() is bypassed.
Regime indicator uses vol_252_lag := shift(vol_252, 1L) before expanding percentile.
Fundamental lag compliance is assumed from daily factor DB snapshots; the run does not verify annual May or quarterly 45-day usable dates.

critical_concerns.description: The package claims XGBoost 5-seed + LightGBM 3-seed ensemble, but the run log says lightgbm is not installed, score_lgbm is 100% NA, and the selected ensemble metrics equal XGB-only metrics. The stated M06 mechanism is therefore not what was executed.

At 2023-12-28, 0 of the latest top-20 alpha names are in KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150, and only 350 of 2434 latest scored names are in that union. This violates the base hard universe before optimizer handoff.

AvgTV20 is computed as shift(frollmean(Size,20)) rather than true trading value such as Close*Vol. Recomputing true lagged 20d trading value for the latest top-20 gives min 67.8m KRW, 9/20 below 2e8, and 4/20 below 1e8.
The package reports top20 turnover_proxy=7.2298, i.e. 722.98% annualized, above the 600% hard cap. Cost and implementability cannot be delegated away at alpha graduation.
subperiod_stability=0.3993 is below the role-prompt 0.50 RF-A1 threshold. The package suppresses RF-A1 by using a lower 0.20 WT-specific threshold, which conflicts with the alpha critic checklist.
recent_3y_icir=1.5908 exceeds full ICIR 0.6551 by more than 1.5x, so the recent-period lift is an explicit overfit warning, not merely a disclosed footnote.

Harvey_t is a simple mean-over-standard-error IC statistic, not Newey-West HAC or 5-spec regression evidence; DSR is labeled proxy, and three of five method candidates have NA metrics despite being counted in the trial penalty.

The package relies on an L-164 ML carve-out to mark C13/C14/C15 as N/A, but the required v6 prompt says Z_Score_Aligned and load_month_factors discipline are mandatory unless formally proven equivalent.
post_neutralization_ic is identical to overall IC because only liquidity filtering was done; sector/size neutral IC, PG2 NAV correlation, and L-219 family saturation checks are deferred to Forge.

Requested risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260426_006, and artifact_lineage.json are absent, so weights schedule, covariance PSD, cond <= 100, and three-source triangulation cannot be verified.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet is not a single snapshot: it has 353635 rows, 182 sig_dates, no duplicate Date-Ticker keys, and max Date 2023-12-28 <= 2026-04-26.
Nominal rank_ic=0.0649 and ICIR=0.6551 exceed minimum alpha lab thresholds if the current invalid universe and liquidity construction are ignored.
C9 regime lag is implemented with shift(vol_252,1), and FF5 features are shifted by one month.
challenge_note.md exists and discloses some RF issues, but disclosure does not cure the hard failures.
unresolved_disputes: Whether L-164 daily ML carve-out is formally valid against the v6 C13/C14/C15 requirements in this task.
Whether any regenerated alpha vector survives after enforcing KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 before ranking.
Whether ICIR remains above 0.20 after true lagged trading-value liquidity filtering replaces Size-based AvgTV20.
Whether PG2 complementarity exists for M06; the package only cites M05 NAV correlation and expects M06 correlation to be lower.
Whether turnover can be brought below 600% annual without destroying IC, since no weights.csv schedule is available.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that the latest top-20 alpha_vector is an actionable KR-market signal even though it was produced outside the mandated index universe and with a Size-based liquidity proxy that lets illiquid names pass.
rebuttal_required: Rerun or relabel the model: either install LightGBM and provide non-null score_lgbm plus ablation metrics, or state honestly that M06 is XGB-only.
Enforce KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 before scoring, ranking, alpha_vector construction, IC diagnostics, and turnover calculation.
Recompute AvgTV20 from true trading value with t-1 lag, then rerun RF-A5 and top-20 liquidity evidence.
Provide valid Newey-West HAC Harvey statistics, 5-spec regression evidence, true DSR, and full method-shopping trial accounting including MI factor selection.
Resolve turnover >600% or mark the package infeasible for graduation.
Provide weights.csv, covariance.parquet with PSD and cond <=100, risk/optimizer packages, and artifact_lineage.json.
Provide explicit Usable_Date <= sig_date evidence or approved loader-equivalence proof for the daily ML path.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The alpha panel exists, but implementation evidence contradicts the claimed ensemble and hard-constraint eligibility. Missing risk/optimizer artifacts mean no two-source PASS can be established.

alpha_specific_questions: After enforcing KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 and true lagged trading value, does rank_IC remain >=0.04 and ICIR remain >=0.20?
Can the strategy satisfy turnover <600% annual after realistic monthly rebalancing and 15bps one-way costs?
What is the true M06 NAV correlation and tail-dependence versus STR_1701, not M05?
What formal authority makes C13/C14/C15 N/A for this daily ML path under the v6 role prompt?
